THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT(this "Agreement") is entered into as of the 1st day of April, 2026, by Voynar LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 802 Manhattan Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11222 ("Owner"), and 802 Manhattan Realty, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 802 Manhattan Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11222 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, designated as Tax Lot 10 in Block 2597 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings, and known as and by street address 800 Manhattan Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11222, as more particularly described in Exhibit "A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof ("Owner Land"), together with the building and improvements thereon, (the “Owner Building", together with the Owner Land, collectively hereinafter called the" Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of that certain land, designated as Tax Lot 11 in Block 2597 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings, and known as and by the street address 802 Manhattan Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11222, as more particularly described in Exhibit "B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof ("Developer Land"), together the building and improvements thereon, (the “Developer Building"); and WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct a new building (together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, the “New Developer Building") upon the Developer Land (the Developer Land, together with the Developer Building and/or the New Developer Building, the “Developer Parcel"), with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if the Developer Land were considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; and WHEREAS, there are Development Rights appurtenant to the Owner Land that are in excess of the Development Rights utilized by the Owner Building or retained by Owner as of the date of this Agreement and are available for transfer in accordance with the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, Owner and Developer have agreed to utilize the procedure available under Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine the Owner Land and the Developer Land so as to confirm the existence of and declare a single zoning lot, which zoning lot may be enlarged making available the Subject Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for use in connection with the construction of the New Developer Building; WHEREAS, all “parties in interest" (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) to the Single Zoning Lot have either executed the Declaration (hereinafter defined) or have waived or have previously waived their right to do so, and have either executed this Agreement or subordinated or previously subordinated their respective interests in the Single Zoning Lot hereto; 1

WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Single Zoning Lot and other matters, and wish to provide to the maximum extent possible for each to exercise its rights in the future without having to seek any consent, approval or other action from the other; WHEREAS, the following are definitions as used in this Agreement: 1. (other than Bonus Development Rights) that may become available to the Single Zoning Lot by expansion of the Single Zoning Lot by adding Additional Parcels in accordance with this Agreement. 2. “Additional Parcel" shall mean any other property within Block 2597 that is contiguous to any portion of the Single Zoning Lot for a minimum of ten (1o) linear feet (or contiguous for a minimum of ten (1o) linear feet with any other lot made part of the Single Zoning Lot).  3.“"Agency" means each or any of following entities: the New York City Department Planning, the New York City Board of Standards and Appeals, the New York City Department of Housing Preservation and Development, the New YorkCityLandmarksPreservation of the City of New York, and/or any other agency or political subdivision of the City of New York, and/or any state or federal agency or political subdivision, or any succesor entity to any of the foregoing. 4. "Business Day” means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday or other day on which commercial banks are authorized to be closed in the State of NewYork. 5. “Bonus Development Rights"”means any bonus floor area and other development rights that are or may become available to the Single Zoning Lot by (1) the provision of an amenity or public benefit, either on or off the Single Zoning Lot, and/or (2) a transfer from a zoning lot that is not included in the Single Zoning Lot, including bonus floor area generated as-of-right, (3) by special permit, authorization or certification, in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, or (4) by Discretionary Approval. 6. “"Casualty” shall mean an event that causes such demolition, damage, destruction, loss or other similar event such that the Owner Building or the Developer Building, or any other building or improvement located on the Single Zoning Lot (as the case may be) cannot be lawfully restored to such building or buildings’² former bulk pursuant to the provisions of the Zoning Resolution regulating the redevelopment of non-complying buildings. 7. "Commercial Development Rights” shall mean Development Rights used for commercial purposes. 2
